judged_text: Admin::EmbeddingController#update ignores the request body entirely and just reserializes the unchanged OpenStruct, so the PUT /admin/customize/embedding route the new admin UI's saveChanges action calls is a silent no-op endpoint. Any admin who expects the embedding settings endpoint to persist changes gets a 200 success with nothing saved; the route ships in the public admin API surface while being inert, and the controller's saveChanges action (admin-embedding.js.es6) is dead code that gives the appearance of persistence semantics that do not exist.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and `@embedding` is an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding` (id + `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)`), with no use of `params` and no persistence logic (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). The frontend controller defines a `saveChanges` action that calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), and an adapter routes `embedding` to PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` (admin/adapters/embedding.js.es6 + routes.rb). So the endpoint/action pair is effectively inert and misleading, but the provided `embedding.hbs` template does not actually invoke `saveChanges`, and host changes are persisted via `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController`, so this is more an incomplete/dead API surface than a directly user-visible broken behavior proven by the diff.
